R1.comparability: same data, mask, model seed and initialisation (gated); the MC stream differs with L, so trajectories are NOT assumed identical

comparisons.auxiliary: (L5, it8) vs (L5, it16) at d=15 only (EMC checkpoint 16)

R1-H1.refute: median slack_45 at d=60 <= at d=15 at either checkpoint
R1-H1.statement: under (L10,it8) and (L10,it16) the median C_Q slack_45 is larger at d=60 than at d=15

R1-H2.refute: median at d=60 >= at d=15, or median at d=60 <= 0, at either checkpoint
R1-H2.statement: under (L10,it8) and (L10,it16) the median 2dH_Lap(4->5) is smaller at d=60 than at d=15 and positive at d=60

R1-H3.refute: fewer than 5 of the complete d=15 datasets are under-selected by C_Q
R1-H3.statement: C_Q under-selects in the majority of d=15 datasets under (L10,it16)

R2.datasets_across_n: independent (A1 data seeds depend on n); same replicate number is NOT a repeated measurement

R2-H1.refute: median at d=30 <= at d=15 at some completed n
R2-H1.statement: at each n, median C_Q slack_45 is larger at d=30 than at d=15 (paired, same data)

R2-H2.refute: median at d=30 >= at d=15 at some completed n
R2-H2.statement: at each n, median 2dH_Lap(4->5) is smaller at d=30 than at d=15

R2-H3.caution: n changes more than Y information (estimation, penalty ln n, P_Z per node); not attributed to Y alone
R2-H3.refute: median at the largest completed n >= at n=50
R2-H3.statement: at d=15, median 2dH_Lap(4->5)/n decreases from n=50 to n=150 (the per-node log-det increment grows with n)

reported_not_predicted: exact counts per n and d

staging.projection: 112 x (pilot EM seconds + pilot evaluation seconds) x 1.25
requires: R2 n=50 and n=100 production runs COMPLETED
projected n=150 wall time from the n=150 pilot fit <= 3 h

common.target: K* = 5 (minimal representation; not K0 uniqueness); under and over are errors

failure_rules: data / replication / init gate failure -> stop before production
RetryDetected -> fit FAILED_NAN, no retry, dataset INCOMPLETE for both criteria
other exception -> stop run, write partial rows
Laplace not OK -> C_Lap INCOMPLETE; no imputation
no seed change, no tolerance change, no resume over existing output

R1: replication: d=30 rep1 K5 s1 at L5/it8 vs d-sweep state
pilot: d=60 rep1 K7 s1 at L10/it16
R2: replication: n=50 d=15 rep1 K5 s1 vs EMC checkpoint 8
pilot: n=150 d=30 rep1 K7 s1
smoke_fits.role: gates only; never counted as data
